endorsements.name: David Aslanian
endorsements.label: BitTorrent Hacks
endorsements.description: This is the journey of two pirates hacking BitTorrent. This talk will cover ways of abusing the BitTorrent protocol, finding vulnerabilities in BitTorrent clients and exploiting them. We will also cover counter measures to these attacks.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 17
